title: Leveraging Cell-level Spatial Transcriptomics as Weak Supervision for Nuclei Classification
abstract: arXiv:2604.23481v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning-based nuclei analysis in histopathology relies heavily on large-scale, expert-curated datasets that are costly and difficult to scale across organs. To address this, we propose a scalable framework leveraging cell-level spatial transcriptomics (ST) as an alternative supervision source for nuclei classification. Cell-level ST provides both gene expression profiles and nucleus masks, enabling automatic generation of image-label pairs without manual annotation. We convert gene expression into cell-type labels and introduce an image-oriented classification strategy to effectively transfer these identities to histopathology images. Evaluated on unseen tissues, our framework achieves comparable segmentation and classification performance compared with conventional supervised approaches, despite using fewer manually annotated datasets.

translated_title: 利用细胞级空间转录组学作为细胞核分类的弱监督
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的组织病理学细胞核分析严重依赖于大规模、由专家精心整理的数据集，这些数据集成本高昂且难以跨器官扩展。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个可扩展的框架，利用细胞级空间转录组学（ST）作为细胞核分类的替代监督来源。细胞级空间转录组学同时提供基因表达谱和细胞核掩膜，能够在无需人工标注的情况下自动生成图像-标签对。我们将基因表达转化为细胞类型标签，并引入一种面向图像的分类策略，以有效地将这些细胞身份信息迁移到组织病理学图像上。在未见过的组织上进行评估，尽管使用的人工标注数据集更少，我们的框架相比传统监督方法仍取得了相当的分割和分类性能。
tldr: 该论文提出利用细胞级空间转录组学作为弱监督来源，自动生成图像-标签对以训练细胞核分类模型，在大幅减少人工标注的情况下达到了与传统监督方法相当的分割和分类性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes leveraging cell-level spatial transcriptomics as weak supervision to automatically generate image-label pairs for nuclei classification, achieving segmentation and classification performance comparable to conventional supervised approaches while requiring far less manual annotation.
